caption: The drawing is executed on a rectangular piece of paper oriented horizontally, with a central rectangular text box bordered by a pattern of alternating yellow, blue, and pink triangles. Above the text box is a large eight-petaled rosette in shades of yellow, blue, and green, enclosed within an arched pink border and flanked by two stylized green fern-like shapes. On either side of the composition, there are two large tulip-shaped flowers with blue outer petals and red-pink inner petals. The upper left and right corners each contain a multicolored, circular, flower-like motif with overlapping petals in blue, pink, yellow, and red. Below these corner motifs, on both sides, are vertical arrangements of small, multi-petaled flowers and diamond-patterned vases in blue, pink, green, yellow, and red. Additional smaller flowers with pink, red, blue, and yellow petals are scattered around the lower half and towards the base of each large tulip. The background is a cream to light tan color, and the entire composition is surrounded by a plain narrow border. In the central text box, the text is handwritten in dark ink.
title: Pa. German Birth Certificate
